i.norm: When the lookup key starts with ':' the prefix is the empty string "". An XmlEncoderStringLookup registered under "" is selected, and the remainder of the key ("'Rk ^bnj|([Bw~^W") is passed to it. The apostrophe is XML-encoded to "'", producing the expected result.
Register an XmlEncoderStringLookup under the empty-string prefix
Build an interpolator with no built-in default lookups; xmlEncoderLookup also serves as the fallback default
